name.zh: Araucaria mirabilis 南洋杉类球果

description.en: A Jurassic fossil preserves large rounded cones attached to a branch.
description.zh: 侏罗纪化石保存附于枝上的大型圆球果。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Araucaria mirabilis, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Araucaria mirabilis 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Robust rounded reproductive architecture is documented independently and is not a new canopy version of the existing generic conifer.
distinctness.zh: 粗壮圆球果结构有独立记录，并非现有普通针叶树的新冠形版本。

modeling_brief.en: Build one branch with a rounded tessellated cone, using preserved scale relief; do not append an imagined whole tree.
modeling_brief.zh: 制作带圆形镶嵌球果的单枝，依据保存鳞片浮雕，不添加想象整树。

uncertainty: No separate Araucaria tree or detached cone asset; Jurassic only because finer age labels differ.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Araucaria mirabilis fossil with attached cones
sources.supports: Jurassic cone-bearing Araucaria mirabilis branch specimen.
